sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Prashant Sharma,Surendra Pratap Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material brought on record.

2. This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.74 of 2021, under Sections - 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Achhalda,
District- Auraiya with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is brother-in-law (devar) of deceased.
The marriage of deceased with brother of applicant has taken place about six years prior to the incident and out of that marriage, they have two children.
Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons, including applicant.

The deceased along Kamlesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107788433/
1 with her husband was residing separately from the applicant and his family members.

sentences.text: In postmortem report, cause of death has been shown throttling but there is absolutely no evidence that applicant was involved in the incident.
During investigation, the applicant was granted interim protection from arrest.

Similarly placed co-accused persons, namely, Rinku @ Dheeraj, Kunti Devi and Ram Naresh have been granted bail by co-ordinate Benches of this Court vide orders dated 27.07.2021, 24.05.2022 & 04.03.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos.25645 of 2021,
56155 of 2021 & 943 of 2022.

sentences.text: Lastly, it was submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 29.02.2024, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
6. The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant - Kamlesh Kumar involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv.
The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
8. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 13.5.2024 SP/-
